# Qoherence

> Qoherence is an end-to-end, expert-level educational repo set on quantum computing and quantum/quantum-inspired AI — grounded in real hardware (IBM, Google, Microsoft, IonQ, Rigetti) and real industry practice. Every page explains ideas in plain English with analogies first, then introduces the math with every symbol explained, then gives real history. Pages are organized into eight sibling repos, each tiered 01-beginner → 02-intermediate → 03-advanced → 04-expert, and chained together into one continuous Prev/Next trail anchored at the root README.

Start at the root [README](README.md) (navigation hub) or [LEARNING-PATH](LEARNING-PATH.md) (recommended reading order). The trail begins at qoherence-core's history page and ends at qoherence-ai's future-outlook page.
